missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Река' stays in the nominative as the subject of 'течёт'. 'Очень быстро' describes the speed of the current.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Реку' is the accusative direct object of 'переплыли'. 'Широкую' agrees in the feminine accusative.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'В реке' uses the prepositional form after 'в' to express location. 'Холодная' agrees with the subject 'вода'.

missions.phrase: Туристы шли к реке через лес.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Dative of direction. 'Реке' is the dative form after 'к', expressing movement toward the river. 'Через лес' shows the path.
Strategic focus: Instrumental object. 'Рекой' is the instrumental governed by 'любовались'. 'Тихой' is the agreeing feminine adjective.
Strategic focus: Genitive of relation. 'Реки' is the genitive after 'берег', showing whose bank it is. 'На берегу' sets the location.
Strategic focus: Accusative after preposition. 'Реку' is the accusative after 'через', showing what the bridge spans. 'Большую' agrees with it.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural of quantity. 'Рек' is the genitive plural after 'много', expressing an indefinite number. 'В этом крае' sets the region.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Реки' is the nominative plural as the subject of 'впадают'. 'Все' quantifies them, and 'в море' is the goal.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'В реке' uses the prepositional form after 'в' to show where the swimming happens. 'Летом' is the instrumental of time.
